source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DP5 SE, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « ES9039Q2M D/A Chip, Ultra-high dynamic range of 126dB, Ultra-low THD+N(0.00009%). »; « Supports streaming playback of DLNA and Airplay. »; « With USB DAC function which can play music from computer by USBjack. »; « Bluetooth with transmiting and receiving function and supports APTX format. »

_a_player_with_a_DAC_and_no_rate: A network player (« Network music streamer ») with its own converter and a USB DAC input, and no sample rate anywhere on the page - the format list (« DSD , WAV , APE , FLAC ») is about files it plays, not a ceiling. Recorded for the converter and the inputs; every block is empty.
